caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #26: AMALGAMATE

amalgamate (verb): to combine into one whole.

✅ In a sentence: The two small school districts amalgamated to share buses and teachers.
✅ Similar: merge, unite, consolidate
✅ Remember it: An "amalgam" is a mixture.
